haiku.problem: The question says the LORD let her enemies become her masters because of her transgressions. Verse 1:5 says the LORD brought her grief because of her transgressions. It doesn't tie the enemies becoming masters to the transgressions, so the question misstates the verse.
Enemies being glad at Jerusalem's trouble is a minor detail. The repeated 'no one to comfort her' theme, which runs through the passage, is clearly more central and has no question in the set.
